devāḥśṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo vāṇīmavahitā mama /
vinaṅkṣyantyaciremaiva sāgarā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
2.52.d:
देवाःशृणुत भद्रं वो वाणीमवहिता मम ।
विनङ्क्ष्यन्त्यचिरेमैव सागरा नात्र संशयः ॥
2.52.m: 'Hear, O gods, may you have good fortune, my words attentively! / In no long time the sons of Sagara will perish; of this there is no doubt.

2.52.s:
kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tena sarvaṃ niyamyate /
nimittamātramanyattu sa eva sakaleśitā //
2.52.d:
कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं तेन सर्वं नियम्यते ।
निमित्तमात्रमन्यत्तु स एव सकलेशिता ॥
2.52.m: Wait for a certain time; everything is restrained by Time. / Everything else is merely an instrumental cause; he alone is the master of all.

2.52.s:
tasmādyuṣmaddhitārthāya yadvakṣyāmi surottamāḥ /
sarvairbhavadbhiradhunā tatkarttavyamataṃ dritaiḥ //
2.52.d:
तस्माद्युष्मद्धितार्थाय यद्वक्ष्यामि सुरोत्तमाः ।
सर्वैर्भवद्भिरधुना तत्कर्त्तव्यमतं द्रितैः ॥
2.52.m: Therefore, for your welfare, what I shall tell you, O best of gods, / that must now be done by all of you without delay.

2.52.s:
viṣṇoraṃśena bhagavānkapilo jayatāṃ varaḥ /
jāto jagaddhitārthāya yogīndrapravaro bhuvi //
2.52.d:
विष्णोरंशेन भगवान्कपिलो जयतां वरः ।
जातो जगद्धितार्थाय योगीन्द्रप्रवरो भुवि ॥
2.52.m: Through a portion of Viṣṇu, the blessed Kapila, best of the victorious, / foremost among lords of yogins, has been born on earth for the welfare of the world.

2.52.s:
agastyapītasalile divyavarṣaśatāvadhi /
dhyāyannāste 'dhunāṃ'bhodhāvekānte tatra kutra cit //
2.52.d:
अगस्त्यपीतसलिले दिव्यवर्षशतावधि ।
ध्यायन्नास्ते ऽधुनांऽभोधावेकान्ते तत्र कुत्र चित् ॥
2.52.m: In the ocean whose waters were drunk by Agastya, for the duration of a hundred divine years, / he now sits meditating in solitude somewhere therein.

2.52.s:
gatvā yūyaṃ mamādeśātkapilaṃ munipuṅgavam /
dhyānāva sānamicchantastiṣṭhadhvaṃ tadupahvare //
2.52.d:
गत्वा यूयं ममादेशात्कपिलं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।
ध्यानाव सानमिच्छन्तस्तिष्ठध्वं तदुपह्वरे ॥
2.52.m: Having gone by my command, wait near that bull among sages, / Kapila, awaiting the end of his meditation.

2.52.s:
samādhiviratau tasya svābhiprāyamaśeṣataḥ /
natvā tasmai vadiṣyadhvaṃ sa vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati //
2.52.d:
समाधिविरतौ तस्य स्वाभिप्रायमशेषतः ।
नत्वा तस्मै वदिष्यध्वं स वः श्रेयो विधास्यति ॥
2.52.m: Upon the cessation of his absorption, having bowed to him, / you shall tell him your intention in full; he will bring about your welfare.

2.52.s:
samādhibhaṅgaśca muneryathā syātsāgaraiḥ kṛtaḥ /
kurudhvaṃ ca tathā yūyaṃ pravṛttiṃ vibudhottamāḥ //
2.52.d:
समाधिभङ्गश्च मुनेर्यथा स्यात्सागरैः कृतः ।
कुरुध्वं च तथा यूयं प्रवृत्तिं विबुधोत्तमाः ॥
2.52.m: And make such an effort, O best of gods, / that the sage's contemplation is disrupted by the sons of Sagara.'

2.52.s:
jaiminiruvāca
ityuktāstena vibudhāstaṃ praṇamya vitāmaham /
gatvā taṃ vibudhaśreṣṭaṃ te kṛtāñjalayo 'bruvan //
2.52.d:
जैमिनिरुवाच
इत्युक्तास्तेन विबुधास्तं प्रणम्य वितामहम् ।
गत्वा तं विबुधश्रेष्टं ते कृताञ्जलयो ऽब्रुवन् ॥
2.52.m: Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by him, the gods bowed to that grandfather, / went to that foremost of sages, and with joined palms said:

2.52.s:
devā ūcuḥ
prasīda no muniśreṣṭha vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ /
upadrutaṃ jagatsarvaṃsāgaraiḥ saṃpraṇaśyati //
2.52.d:
देवा ऊचुः
प्रसीद नो मुनिश्रेष्ठ वयं त्वां शरणं गताः ।
उपद्रुतं जगत्सर्वंसागरैः संप्रणश्यति ॥
2.52.m: The gods said: / 'Be pleased with us, O best of sages! We have taken refuge in you. / The entire world, harassed by the sons of Sagara, is perishing.

2.52.s:
tvaṃ kilākhilalokānāṃ sthitisahārakāraṇaḥ /
viṣṇoraṃśena yogīndrasvarūpī bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ //
2.52.d:
त्वं किलाखिललोकानां स्थितिसहारकारणः ।
विष्णोरंशेन योगीन्द्रस्वरूपी भुवि संस्थितः ॥
2.52.m: You indeed are the cause of preservation and destruction of all the worlds; / you abide on earth as a portion of Viṣṇu in the form of a lord of yogins.

2.52.s:
puṃsāṃ tāpatrayārttānāmārtināśāya kevalam /
svecchayā te dhṛto deho na tu tvaṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ //
2.52.d:
पुंसां तापत्रयार्त्तानामार्तिनाशाय केवलम् ।
स्वेच्छया ते धृतो देहो न तु त्वं तपतां वरः ॥
2.52.m: A body was assumed by you of your own will solely to destroy the distress / of men afflicted by the threefold suffering; you are indeed the foremost of ascetics.

2.52.s:
manasaiva jagatsarvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumeva ca /
vidhātuṃ svecchayā brahmanbhavāñchakrotyasaṃśayam //
2.52.d:
मनसैव जगत्सर्वं स्रष्टुं संहर्तुमेव च ।
विधातुं स्वेच्छया ब्रह्मन्भवाञ्छक्रोत्यसंशयम् ॥
2.52.m: With your mind alone, O Brahman, you are without doubt able / to create, destroy, and arrange the entire world according to your will.

2.52.s:
tvaṃ no dhātā vidhātā ca tvaṃ gurustvaṃ parāyaṇam /
paritrātā tvamasmākaṃ vinivarttaya cāpadam //
2.52.d:
त्वं नो धाता विधाता च त्वं गुरुस्त्वं परायणम् ।
परित्राता त्वमस्माकं विनिवर्त्तय चापदम् ॥
2.52.m: You are our creator and ordainer; you are our teacher; you are our supreme refuge; / you are our protector; please avert this misfortune.

2.52.s:
śaraṇaṃ bhava viprendra vipredrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
sāgarairdahyamānānāṃ lokatrayanivāsinām //
2.52.d:
शरणं भव विप्रेन्द्र विप्रेद्राणां विशेषतः ।
सागरैर्दह्यमानानां लोकत्रयनिवासिनाम् ॥
2.52.m: Be a refuge, O best of brāhmaṇas, especially for the foremost brāhmaṇas / and the inhabitants of the three worlds who are scorched by the sons of Sagara.

2.52.s:
nanu vai sāttvikī ceṣṭā bhavatīha bhavādṛśām /
trātumarhasi tasmāttvaṃ lokānasmāṃśca suvrata //
2.52.d:
ननु वै सात्त्विकी चेष्टा भवतीह भवादृशाम् ।
त्रातुमर्हसि तस्मात्त्वं लोकानस्मांश्च सुव्रत ॥
2.52.m: Indeed, for beings like you, conduct here is consisting of sattva. / Therefore, O you of noble vows, you ought to protect the worlds and us.

2.52.s:
na cedakāle bhagavanvinaṅkṣyatyakhilaṃ jagat /
jaiminiruvāca
ityuktaḥ sakalairdevairunmīlya nayane śanaiḥ //
2.52.d:
न चेदकाले भगवन्विनङ्क्ष्यत्यखिलं जगत् ।
जैमिनिरुवाच
इत्युक्तः सकलैर्देवैरुन्मील्य नयने शनैः ॥
2.52.m: If not, the entire world will perish before its time, O blessed one!' / Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by all the gods, slowly opening his eyes,

2.52.s:
vilokya tānuvācedaṃ kapilaḥ sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ /
svakarmaṇaiva nirdagdhāḥ pravinaṅkṣyanti sāgarāḥ //
2.52.d:
विलोक्य तानुवाचेदं कपिलः सूनृतं वचः ।
स्वकर्मणैव निर्दग्धाः प्रविनङ्क्ष्यन्ति सागराः ॥
2.52.m: Kapila looked at them and spoke this true and pleasant word: / 'Scorched by their own actions, the sons of Sagara will surely perish.'

2.52.s:
kāle prāpte tu yuṣmābhiḥ satāvatparipālyatām /
ahaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ vināśāya durātmanām //
2.52.d:
काले प्राप्ते तु युष्माभिः सतावत्परिपाल्यताम् ।
अहं तु कारणं तेषां विनाशाय दुरात्मनाम् ॥
2.52.m: “When the right time arrives, you should just wait patiently. / I myself will be the cause for the destruction of those wicked ones.

2.52.s:
bhaviṣyāmi suraśreṣṭhā bhavatāmarthasiddhaye /
mama krodhāgni vipluṣṭāḥ sāgarāḥ pāpacetasaḥ //
2.52.d:
भविष्यामि सुरश्रेष्ठा भवतामर्थसिद्धये ।
मम क्रोधाग्नि विप्लुष्टाः सागराः पापचेतसः ॥
2.52.m: O best of gods, I shall bring about the accomplishment of your aim. / Scorched by the fire of my anger, the sons of Sagara of evil intent,

2.52.s:
bhaviṣyantu cireṇaiva kālopahatabuddhayaḥ /
tasmādgatajvarā devā lokāścaivākutobhayāḥ //
2.52.d:
भविष्यन्तु चिरेणैव कालोपहतबुद्धयः ।
तस्माद्गतज्वरा देवा लोकाश्चैवाकुतोभयाः ॥
2.52.m: their minds ruined by Time, will before long meet their end. / Therefore let the gods be freed from anxiety, and let the worlds be free from danger on every side!

2.52.s:
bhavantu te durācārāḥ kṣipraṃ yāsyanti saṃkṣayam /
tadyūyaṃ nirbhayā bhūtvā vrajadhvaṃ svāṃ purīṃ prati //
2.52.d:
भवन्तु ते दुराचाराः क्षिप्रं यास्यन्ति संक्षयम् ।
तद्यूयं निर्भया भूत्वा व्रजध्वं स्वां पुरीं प्रति ॥
2.52.m: Let those of evil conduct quickly perish! / Therefore, becoming fearless, depart to your own city.

2.52.s:
kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tato 'bhīṣṭamavāpsyatha /
kapilenaivamuktāste devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ //
2.52.d:
कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं ततो ऽभीष्टमवाप्स्यथ ।
कपिलेनैवमुक्तास्ते देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः ॥
2.52.m: Wait for a short time; then you will obtain what you desire.” / Addressed thus by Kapila, all those gods, together with Indra,

2.52.s:
taṃ praṇamya tato jagmuḥ pratītāgnidivaṃ prati /
etasminnantare rājā sagaraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ //
2.52.d:
तं प्रणम्य ततो जग्मुः प्रतीताग्निदिवं प्रति ।
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा सगरः पृथिवीपतिः ॥
2.52.m: bowed down to him and then departed satisfied toward heaven. / In the meantime, King Sagara, the lord of the earth,

2.52.s:
vājimedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kartuṃ cakre manoratham /
āhṛtya sarvasaṃbhārānvasiṣṭhānumate tadā //
2.52.d:
वाजिमेधं महायज्ञं कर्तुं चक्रे मनोरथम् ।
आहृत्य सर्वसंभारान्वसिष्ठानुमते तदा ॥
2.52.m: formed the desire to perform the great sacrifice, the horse sacrifice. / Having gathered all the sacrificial materials with Vasiṣṭha’s approval,

2.52.s:
aurvādyaiḥ sahito viprairyathāvaddīkṣito 'bhavat /
dīkṣāṃ praviṣṭo nṛpatirhayasaṃcāraṇāya vai //
2.52.d:
और्वाद्यैः सहितो विप्रैर्यथावद्दीक्षितो ऽभवत् ।
दीक्षां प्रविष्टो नृपतिर्हयसंचारणाय वै ॥
2.52.m: he was duly consecrated together with Aurva and the other Brahmins. / Having entered upon the consecration, the king, for the wandering of the horse,

2.52.s:
putrānsarvānsamāhūya saṃdideśa mahayaśāḥ /
saṃcārayitvā turagaṃ parītya pṛthivītale //
2.52.d:
पुत्रान्सर्वान्समाहूय संदिदेश महयशाः ।
संचारयित्वा तुरगं परीत्य पृथिवीतले ॥
2.52.m: summoned all his sons and instructed them, he of great renown: / “Having let the horse roam about, going around the surface of the earth,

2.52.s:
kṣipraṃ mamāntikaṃ putrāḥ punarāhartumarhatha /
jaiminiruvāca
tataste piturādeśāttamādāya turaṅgamam //
2.52.d:
क्षिप्रं ममान्तिकं पुत्राः पुनराहर्तुमर्हथ ।
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततस्ते पितुरादेशात्तमादाय तुरङ्गमम् ॥
2.52.m: O sons, you must bring it back quickly to my presence.” / Jaimini said: / Then, by their father’s command, taking that horse,

2.52.s:
paricaṅkramayāmāsuḥ sakale kṣitimaṇḍale /
vidhicodanayaivāśvaḥ sa bhūmau parivartitataḥ //
2.52.d:
परिचङ्क्रमयामासुः सकले क्षितिमण्डले ।
विधिचोदनयैवाश्वः स भूमौ परिवर्तिततः ॥
2.52.m: they led it roaming over the entire circle of the earth. / The horse was made to wander over the earth solely by injunction of ritual ordinance,

2.52.s:
na tu digvijayārthāya karādānārthameva ca /
pṛthivībhūbhujā tena pūrvameva vinirjitā //
2.52.d:
न तु दिग्विजयार्थाय करादानार्थमेव च ।
पृथिवीभूभुजा तेन पूर्वमेव विनिर्जिता ॥
2.52.m: not for the purpose of conquering the quarters or exacting tribute; / for the earth had already been conquered beforehand by that monarch,

2.52.s:
nṛpāścodāravīryeṇa karadāḥ samare kṛtāḥ /
tataste rājatanayā nistoye lavaṇāṃbudhau //
2.52.d:
नृपाश्चोदारवीर्येण करदाः समरे कृताः ।
ततस्ते राजतनया निस्तोये लवणांबुधौ ॥
2.52.m: and kings had been made tribute-payers in battle through his noble valor. / Then those princes, at the salt ocean deprived of its water,

2.52.s:
bhūtale viviśurhṛṣṭāḥ parivārya turaṅgamam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya uvoddhātapāde sagaravarite 'śvamocanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 52//
2.52.d:
भूतले विविशुर्हृष्टाः परिवार्य तुरङ्गमम् ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उवोद्धातपादे सगरवरिते ऽश्वमोचनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ॥ 52॥
2.52.m:
entered the ground, delighted, surrounding the horse.

Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, entitled “The Release of the Horse” in the story of Sagara, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle part, in the great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 52
